results.title: Mandaadi X review: Soori and Suhas impress, but fans call out a 'highly predictable' story and 'illogical climax'
results.description: Mathimaran Pugazhendhi’s boat-racing sports drama Mandaadi has received mixed reactions after its theatrical release, with Soori and Suhas’ performances and GV Prakash Kumar’s music earning praise, while predictable writing and a disappointing second half have drawn criticism.
